summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullish bets on the S&P 500, evidenced by massive premium accumulation in SPX 6000C and 7000C strikes expiring in 2026. While there is significant hedging via SPX 8000P positions, the sheer scale of multi-day persistent buying in the 6000C and 7000C (totaling billions in premium) suggests a dominant long-term macro-bullish conviction. TSM stands out as a high-conviction intraday outlier with an extreme P/C ratio of 0.09 and $441.5M in BuyCalls. Traders should watch for continued volatility in the semiconductor space (TSM, MU) and monitor if the SPX 8000P hedging activity intensifies, which could signal an increase in tail-risk protection despite the bullish call bias.
